description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeMembershipDao class, which provides data access methods for the EmployeeMembership entity within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee membership records, utilizing Doctrine ORM for database interactions.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for EmployeeMembership entities, facilitating CRUD operations and search queries related to employee memberships in the database.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeMembership entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeMembership record for a specific employee number and membership ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeMembershipIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns a list of existing EmployeeMembership IDs for a given employee number, filtered by a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeMemberships
methods.description: Deletes EmployeeMembership records for a specific employee based on provided IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Performs a search for employee memberships based on filter parameters, returning matching records.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for employee membership search results with applied filters and sorting.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee memberships matching the search filter parameters.
